detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #17 CPU and Memory Capability Profiles A believable device profile needs believable capabilities. PH4NTXM derives reported CPU cores, threads, and memory from the selected device class and hardware ecosystem. Older and compact profiles receive suitable limits, and reported RAM is constrained by the usable memory available on the host. The completed capability environment is shared with reporting, graphics, display, and browser components. Lone Wolf uses its independent session state for bounded selections. The resulting profile gives participating components a common set of values to work from throughout the session. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
